Initial release of benxiang-memory: a deterministic, persistent project state server for AI collaborations.

- Separates volatile chat history from persistent world/project state using the MCP Server.
- Adds commands for state projection (`origin_state`), transactional commits (`origin_commit`), change traceability (`origin_why`), history review, and diagnostics.
- Enforces strict, machine-verifiable constraints on state transitions and object creation.
- All project state changes are committed as rationale-backed semantic transactions; zero writes on failed transactions.
- Enables instant recovery of project context and precise accountability for every state field.
- Provides e2e tests for protocol correctness and determinism.
